The petitioner not being satisfied with the quantum of compensation awarded by the Tribunal in MCOP No.2090 of 2018, dated 19.10.2022 has preferred this appeal seeking for enhancement of compensation.

2.The case of the petitioner is that on 14.01.2018 at about 07.00 p.m. while the petitioner was riding as a pillion rider in a two wheeler bearing Regn. No. TN-03 S-4251 proceeding near Kumaran Nagar signal, Semanjeri, OMR from north to south direction in a rash and negligent manner endangering public safety dashed against a car coming from the same road from south to north direction.
Due to which, the petitioner was thrown out and sustained multiple grievous injuries all over the body, for which he underwent treatment in the hospital.
Under these circumstances, the claim petition came to be filed before the Tribunal seeking for payment of compensation of Rs.35,00,000/-.
https://www.mhc.tn.gov.in/judis ( Uploaded on: 19/06/2025 01:26:36 pm )

3.The Tribunal on considering the facts and circumstances of the case and on appreciation of oral and documentary evidence, came to a conclusion that the accident had taken place only due to the rash and negligent driving on the part of the rider of the 1st respondent.

Having come to such a conclusion, the Tribunal fixed the total compensation payable at Rs.3,90,000/- under various heads as follows:
 S.No Compensation awarded under   the head   1. Disability   2. Pain and sufferings   3. Transportation   4. Extra Nourishment   5. Attender charges   6. Loss of income   7. Loss of amenities

Total  4.The above compensation was directed to be paid with interest at the rate of 7.5% per annum.

sentences.text: On perusal of award passed by the Tribunal below, the fact reveals that the tribunal failed to take note that the accident was happened in the year of 2018 and at the time of accident, the petitioner was a Carpenter.
So, considering the age and other relevant factor of petitioner, the notional income was fixed as Rs.11,000/- for 48 days.

On considering the injuries as well as treatment period, the learned Tribunal fixed 48 days for loss of income, but the learned counsel for appellant argues that due to the injuries sustained, he was not able to move outside and nearly about six months, he was not able to move and restrained in his house.
Hence, six months period is to be taken for loss of income.

By way of reply, the learned counsel for 2nd respondent would submit that only 48 days, he is in hospital, but however on seeing the grievous injury, this Court is inclined to modify the treatment period from 48 days to six months.
The accident was happened in the year 2018.

Therefore, on considering the cost of living, this Court is inclined to enhance the notional income as Rs.15000/- per month and https://www.mhc.tn.gov.in/judis ( Uploaded on: 19/06/2025 01:26:36 pm ) towards paid and sufferings, it has been enhanced from Rs.40,000/- to Rs.60,000/-.
The compensation that has been fixed under the other heads are reasonable and does not require the interference of this Court.

7.In the light of the above discussion, the compensation awarded by the tribunal is modified as follows:
 S.No Compensation awarded under   the head   1. Disability (26% x Rs.5000) 
 2. Pain and Suffering   3. Transportation   4. Extra nourishment   5. Attender charges   6. Loss of income (Rs.15,000 x 6) 
 7. Loss of amenities   Total  8.The compensation awarded by the tribunal at Rs.2,41,400/- is enhanced to Rs.3,35,000/-.

The second respondent insurance company is directed to deposit the enhanced compensation of Rs.3,35,000/-, less the amount already deposited, together with interest at 7.5% p.a. from the date of claim petition till the date of deposit within a period of eight weeks from the date of receipt of this https://www.mhc.tn.gov.in/judis ( Uploaded on: 19/06/2025 01:26:36 pm ) judgment.
Insofar as the enhanced compensation is concerned, the deficit court fee, if not paid, shall be paid by the claimants.
The other directions issued by the Tribunal with regard to the mode of payment of compensation remains unaltered.
